Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. three soldiers crows (bullish)

Rule: 3 bars same colour, each closing beyond the previous close, each opening inside the previous body, bodies > 0.5 x avgB10, shadow on the close side <= 0.3 x body. 1,740 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

three soldiers crows (bearish)

Rule: 3 bars same colour, each closing beyond the previous close, each opening inside the previous body, bodies > 0.5 x avgB10, shadow on the close side <= 0.3 x body. 1,372 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

three inside (bullish)

Rule: harami (body2 inside body1) then bar3 closes beyond open1 in the reversal direction. 2,126 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

three inside (bearish)

Rule: harami (body2 inside body1) then bar3 closes beyond open1 in the reversal direction. 2,096 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

inside bar (neutral)

Rule: high < previous high AND low > previous low. 115,030 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

outside bar (bullish)

Rule: high > previous high AND low < previous low; direction of the close vs open. 38,539 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
